digest.component_or_area: dependency management and uv universal resolver
propositions: uv's universal resolver locks all extras jointly and downgrades pydantic-ai-slim to 1.38.0 because [eval] pins boto3<1.40.62 while [bedrock] and [dev] require boto3>=1.42.63, creating an unresolvable conflict
pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0 cannot import AnthropicModel due to missing UserLocation type in anthropic 0.120.2, breaking local dev and plan-review/code-review LLM gates at import time
pip installs succeed with pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.1 + anthropic 0.120.2 because it resolves extras independently and never co-installs [eval] with [bedrock] or [dev]
declaring [tool.uv] conflicts for [eval]⊥[bedrock] and [eval]⊥[dev] plus raising pydantic-ai-slim floor to >=1.107,<2 resolves uv to the healthy 1.107.1 + 0.120.2 pair
a from-scratch uv lock after the floor bump and conflicts declaration must resolve pydantic-ai-slim>=1.107 with compatible anthropic, verified by import smoke test in CI
